verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API (v3) and machine-readable Swagger/OpenAPI specs, plus an MCP server. None of it mentions an official client SDK library in any language. A REST API and OpenAPI spec are only developer building blocks from which a client could be generated, and the MCP server belongs to a different story, so neither earns credit for official SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
